Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We need to accelerate the pilot and want to add an additional throughput commitment to cover higher peak processing during our ingest window.

Specifically:
- Add 200,000 token/month burst capacity for the pilot month (Sept).
- Move our committed tier from 500k/month to a stepped schedule (500k months 1-2, 700k months 3-6).
- We also asked procurement to propose whether this is an Order Form addendum or requires an MSA amendment for the effective date and billing cadence.

I've attached our redlines to the Order Form (LumenOrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf) and a short note from procurement. Best,

Subject: Re: Request: add throughput for pilot + updated pricing table

Hi Marta — great to hear the pilot is moving faster.

Quick answers up front:
1) In most cases, stepped volume/pricing can be handled as an Order Form addendum (change order) and does not require an MSA text change.
2) If both sides sign the change order via DocuSign, we can typically get it executed within 3 business days; turnaround may lengthen if Legal requests new MSA clauses.
3) We can do pro‑rata invoicing for the add-on in Sept. We just need the signed change order and the billing PO.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll loop in Legal for a quick lookout on any DEI/tax or revenue recognition flags (cc'ing Legal).
- Rishi (AE) can confirm pricing and create a formal change order draft for signature.
- Grace (Customer Success) will align on the operational rollout and any SOW edits for integration work.

I'll follow up after Legal confirms whether the redlines in the attached PDF are Order Form-only.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

I'll prepare the draft change order by EOD tomorrow.
